Name: Bonster's Poultry
Author: rjgilber
Description:
Have you ever wanted more cute ducks wandering around your farm? Well, this is the mod for you! Bonster's Poultry adds three new duck breeds to Stardew Valley - the Swedish, the Saxony, and the Abacot Ranger. All three are real-world duck breeds, now rendered in pixels.
Purchase these ducks at Marnie's - they cost the same as a standard duck, and their eggs will make duck mayonnaise. If they like you, they may drop feathers. Each breed has their own egg - hatch them in your coop incubator to run your own little duck industry. Quack~

Version 2.0 adds in the Ancona, Aylesbury, Buff and Cayuga!

Future plans: adding more breeds of duck, and branching out to other types of poultry, like chicken, geese and turkey.

Downloads.Description: Adds duck breeds to game: this update fixes issue with duck feathers being produced too frequently, and brings the number of breeds to seven!
